Commentary.Commentary: We are back with the chase. The Scotland Under-19 fielders are seen in a hurdle. The Scottish players take the field and Qasim Khan will take the new ball. Steve Stolk and Lhuan-dre Pretorius are the openers for South Africa Under-19. Let's play says the Umpire!
... RUN CHASE ...

On the other end, Scotland Under-19 displayed a cautious start to their batting innings, successfully negotiating the fiery pace attack of South Africa Under-19 in the initial 10 overs without losing any wickets and adding 27 runs. Adi Hegde, however, departed just after the first powerplay, contributing a patient 5 runs off 33 balls. Alec Price held his ground at one end, and as Jamie Dunk began to accelerate, the scoring rate saw an uptick. Despite the dismissal of Alec Price, the skipper Owen Gould, leading from the front, orchestrated a standout partnership of 115 runs with Jamie Dunk. The duo effectively increased the scoring rate, and the partnership was broken with Jamie departing after a well-made 90 runs. Uzair Ahmad injected some quick momentum with a brisk 23 off 8 deliveries. The skipper, Owen, played a gem of an innings and fell just short of a well-deserved century by a mere 3 runs. Although the Scotland tail couldn't contribute significantly in the final overs, the team managed to post a formidable total of 269 on the scoreboard. Will we see another upset with Scotland Under-19 scripting history? Or will the Proteas gun down this total? Let's find out as the chase comes to you shortly.

After opting to bowl first upon winning the toss, South Africa Under-19 began the innings with an eagerness to secure early wickets but faced challenges in maintaining precision with their lines and lengths. Despite keeping a check on the scoring rate during the initial powerplay, the breakthrough proved elusive for the Proteas. It was Riley Norton who made the breakthrough, delivering a beautiful yorker in his second over to dismantle Adi Hegde's stumps and provide South Africa with their first wicket. Jamie Dunk and Alec Price then built a resilient partnership, with Price getting a life at 10 runs after being dropped by the wicketkeeper. However, his innings was cut short by Sipho Potsane at 18 runs. The partnership between Jamie Dunk and skipper Owen Gould added to the frustration for the Proteas but was eventually broken by Riley Norton, who not only claimed the pivotal wicket of Jamie Dunk but also dismissed the aggressive Uzair Ahmad. Kwena Maphaka joined the wicket-taking party by sending Bahadar Esakhiel back to the pavilion without scoring any runs, followed by the crucial dismissal of Scotland's skipper, Owen Gould. Although South Africa Under-19 managed to pull things back in the last 5 overs, securing important wickets, they are now faced with the challenge of batting well in their chase.

A brilliant partnership between Jamie Dunk, scoring an impressive 90 runs and skipper Owen Gould, who finished with a superb 97, has placed Scotland Under-19 in a commanding position at the end of the first innings posting a total of 269 runs on the scoreboard. Despite a late resurgence from the South African side, Scotland's strong batting display has undoubtedly put them in the driver's seat.
